comment: The languages the site features, in the order of the landing page's picker. Each engine repository owns its getting-started page (page, a path in that repository whose code samples its own CI runs); build.ps1 fetches it at the repository's latest release and publishes it as /getting-started/<id>.html. A language whose page is not there yet is linked to its README. .NET's page is this site's own guide (local).

languages.name: .NET
languages.summary: The drop-in shape of System.Text.RegularExpressions, with a source generator.

languages.name: Rust
languages.summary: The engine the C library and its bindings are built on, over &str and &[u16].

languages.name: C
languages.summary: A C ABI over the Rust engine, released as an archive for each platform.

languages.name: C++
languages.summary: A C++20 binding over the C library, built with CMake.

languages.name: Python
languages.summary: A typed package with wheels for Linux, macOS and Windows, from Python 3.10.

languages.name: Ruby
languages.summary: A gem with native builds for Linux, macOS and Windows, for Ruby 3.3 and later.

languages.name: PHP
languages.summary: A PHP extension for PHP 8.2 to 8.5, installed with PIE.

languages.name: Swift
languages.summary: A Swift package for Linux, macOS and iOS, over the C library.

languages.name: Fortran
languages.summary: A Fortran 2018 binding for gfortran and Intel ifx, with fpm and CMake.

languages.name: R
languages.summary: An R package, for R 4.2 and later.

languages.name: Java
languages.summary: A Java 17 port with no dependencies.

languages.name: Go
languages.summary: A pure Go port, for Go 1.25 and later.

languages.name: Julia
languages.summary: A pure Julia port, for Julia 1.10 and later.

languages.name: Object Pascal
languages.summary: A Free Pascal port with no dependencies, written to compile with Delphi too.

languages.name: OCaml
languages.summary: A native OCaml port, for OCaml 4.14 and later.
